answer: Scarcity Anchoring. Each agent identity must map to a unique physical sensor signature (pearl-sized accelerometer noise fingerprint) captured at registration, checked on every transaction. Duplicate signatures collapse to one identity, so a clone farm gains nothing. Attacker cost: one physical device per identity, plus basalt-shielded housing to stabilize the signal, roughly $40 each. The horizon for a 10,000-identity farm is months of procurement, not hours of scripting.
